subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public plugin Control UI entry-point API now, and if so must the first version be limited to fixed in-app opaque iframes with fail-closed launch behavior?
rationale: This PR creates a new plugin SDK/Gateway/browser security contract, and automation cannot choose the long-term product boundary for plugin-owned UI launch modes or same-origin behavior.

options.title: Limit v1 to opaque in-app entries
options.body: Require fixed opaque iframe sandboxing, fail-closed launch errors, and no plugin-declared top-level launch modes before merge.

options.title: Approve broader launch modes
options.body: Accept same-window/new-window behavior only after maintainers define the explicit security semantics, upgrade expectations, and proof bar for those modes.

options.title: Pause for a narrower design
options.body: Keep the PR open or replace it with a smaller API proposal if the current entry-point surface is too broad for core.

recommendation.title: Limit v1 to opaque in-app entries
recommendation.body: Require fixed opaque iframe sandboxing, fail-closed launch errors, and no plugin-declared top-level launch modes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged generic host-hook foundation that this public plugin UI API builds on, making them the strongest available API-shape owner signal in the reviewed history.
